title: A Message from Tom
text:
Hi Anna, thanks for your email! I am sorry I did not reply sooner. I was busy with my new job. This weekend I am free, so let's meet for coffee on Saturday.

The coffee shop is near my house, on Green Street. It opens at ten o'clock. Please bring your photos from our trip to Spain. See you soon! Tom

questions.text: Why did Tom not reply sooner?
options: He was busy with his new job.
He was on holiday in Spain.
He did not have a phone.

questions.text: What time does the coffee shop open?
What is the most likely reason Tom writes this email?
options: To plan a meeting with Anna.
To tell Anna about a new house.

questions.text: Where did Tom and Anna probably travel together?

vocabulary.definition: having a lot of things to do
not busy; having time to do something
take something with you to a place

paragraph_translations: Cześć Anna, dzięki za maila! Przepraszam, że nie odpisałem wcześniej. Byłem zajęty nową pracą. W ten weekend jestem wolny, więc spotkajmy się na kawie w sobotę.
Kawiarnia jest blisko mojego domu, na Green Street. Otwiera się o dziesiątej. Proszę, przynieś zdjęcia z naszej wycieczki do Hiszpanii. Do zobaczenia wkrótce! Tom
